sizeEntry.name: 體型：
entries: 中型（身高約 4–7 呎）或小型（身高約 2–4 呎），於選擇此種族時決定

entries.name: 天界抗性
entries: 你對黯蝕傷害與光耀傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}。

entries.name: 黑暗視覺
entries: 你擁有範圍 60 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB}。

entries.name: 治癒之手
entries: 作為一個{@action Magic|XPHB}動作，你碰觸一個生物，並擲數量等同於你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的 d4。該生物恢復等同於擲骰總和的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}。使用此特性後，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}前都無法再次使用。

entries.name: 光明使者
entries: 你知道{@spell Light|XPHB}戲法。魅力是你施展此戲法的施法屬性。

entries.name: 天界啟示
entries: 當你達到角色等級 3 時，你可以作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}進行變身，使用下列選項之一（每次變身時選擇）。變身持續 1 分鐘，或直到你結束它為止（無需動作）。變身後，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}前都無法再次變身。
在變身結束前，於你的每個回合中一次，當你以攻擊或法術對一個目標造成傷害時，你可以對該目標造成額外傷害。額外傷害等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}；若為「黯蝕屍衣」，額外傷害類型為黯蝕，若為「天界之翼」與「內在光輝」則為光耀。
變身選項如下：

items.name: 天界之翼
entries: 兩片幽靈般的翅膀暫時從你背上長出。直到變身結束前，你擁有等同於你{@variantrule Speed|XPHB}的{@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB}。

items.name: 內在光輝
entries: 灼熱的光芒暫時從你的雙眼與口中散發出來。在持續時間內，你在 10 呎半徑內發出{@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}，並在其外額外 10 呎發出{@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}；在你的每個回合結束時，你 10 呎內的每個生物受到等同於你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的光耀傷害。

items.name: 黯蝕屍衣
entries: 你的雙眼短暫化為兩潭黑暗，無法飛行的翅膀暫時從你背上長出。你 10 呎內除盟友以外的生物，必須通過一次魅力豁免檢定（{@dc 8} + 你的魅力調整值 + 你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}），否則處於{@condition Frightened|XPHB}狀態直到你的下個回合結束。

sizeEntry.name: 體型：
entries: 中型（身高約 5–7 呎）

entries.name: 龍族血統
entries: 你的血脈源自一位龍族祖先。從「龍族祖先」表中選擇龍的種類。你的選擇會影響你的吐息武器與{@variantrule Damage|XPHB|傷害}{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}特性，以及你的外貌。

entries.name: 吐息武器
entries: 當你在自己的回合執行{@action Attack|XPHB}動作時，你可以將其中一次攻擊替換為吐出魔法能量，形成 15 呎{@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|錐形}或長 30 呎、寬 5 呎的{@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|直線}（每次選擇形狀）。該區域內的每個生物必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定（{@dc 8} + 你的體質調整值 + 你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}）。豁免失敗時，生物受到 {@damage 1d10} 傷害，類型由你的龍族血統特性決定。豁免成功時，生物受到的傷害減半。此傷害在你達到角色等級 5（{@damage 2d10}）、11（{@damage 3d10}）與 17（{@damage 4d10}）時各增加 {@damage 1d10}。
你可以使用此吐息武器的次數等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}時恢復所有已消耗的次數。

entries.name: 傷害抗性
entries: 你對你的龍族血統特性所決定的傷害類型具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}。

entries.name: 黑暗視覺
entries: 你擁有範圍 60 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB}。

entries.name: 龍族飛行
entries: 當你達到角色等級 5 時，你可以引導龍族魔法讓自己暫時飛行。作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}，你的背上長出幽靈般的翅膀，持續 10 分鐘，或直到你收起翅膀（無需動作）或處於{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}狀態為止。在此期間，你擁有等同於你{@variantrule Speed|XPHB}的{@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB}。你的翅膀看起來是由與你吐息武器相同的能量構成。使用此特性後，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}前都無法再次使用。

items.name: Breath Weapon
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} or a 30-foot {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Constitution modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 1d10} {{damageType}} damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by {@damage 1d10} when you reach character levels 5 ({@damage 2d10}), 11 ({@damage 3d10}), and 17 ({@damage 4d10}).
You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

items.name: Damage Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to {{damageType}} damage.

sizeEntry.name: 體型：
entries: 中型（身高約 4–5 呎）

entries.name: 黑暗視覺
entries: 你擁有範圍 120 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB}。

entries.name: 矮人韌性
entries: 你對毒素傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}。你為避免或終止{@condition Poisoned|XPHB}狀態所進行的豁免檢定也具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}。

entries.name: 矮人堅韌
entries: 你的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}上限提升 1，且每當你獲得一個等級時再提升 1。

entries.name: 石材知識
entries: 作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}，你獲得範圍 60 呎的{@sense Tremorsense|XPHB}，持續 10 分鐘。你必須位於石質表面上或碰觸石質表面，才能使用此{@sense Tremorsense|XPHB}。石頭可以是天然或經過加工的。
你可以使用此{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}的次數等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}時恢復所有已消耗的次數。

sizeEntry.name: 體型：
entries: 中型（身高約 5–6 呎）

entries.name: 黑暗視覺
entries: 你擁有範圍 60 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB}。

entries.name: 精靈血系
entries: 你屬於一個賦予你超自然能力的血系。從「精靈血系」表中選擇一個血系。你獲得該血系的 1 級益處。
當你達到角色等級 3 與 5 時，你學會一道更高環的法術，如表中所示。你總是準備著該法術。你可以不消耗法術欄位施展它一次，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}時恢復以此方式施展它的能力。你也可以使用你擁有的適當環階法術欄位施展該法術。
智力、感知或魅力為你以此特性施展之法術的施法屬性（於選擇血系時決定）。

entries.caption: 精靈血系
rows: 你的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB}範圍增加到 120 呎。你也知道{@spell Dancing Lights|XPHB}戲法。
你知道{@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB}戲法。每當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}時，你可以將該戲法替換為另一道{@filter 法師法術列表上的戲法|spells|level=0|class=Wizard}。
你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB}增加到 35 呎。你也知道{@spell Druidcraft|XPHB}戲法。

entries.name: 妖精血統
entries: 你為避免或終止{@condition Charmed|XPHB}狀態所進行的豁免檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}。

entries.name: 敏銳感官
entries: 你獲得{@skill Insight|XPHB}、{@skill Perception|XPHB}或{@skill Survival|XPHB}技能其中一項的熟練。

entries.name: 出神
entries: 你不需要睡眠，魔法也無法使你入睡。若你花費 4 小時進行出神般的冥想，並在期間保持意識，你就能完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}。

items.name: Elven Lineage (Drow)
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. The range of your {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} increases to 120 feet. You also know the {@spell Dancing Lights|XPHB} cantrip.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Darkness|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

items.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.

items.name: Elven Lineage (High Elf)
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. You know the {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} cantrip. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace that cantrip with a different {@filter cantrip from the Wizard spell list|spells|level=0|class=Wizard}.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

items.name: Elven Lineage (Wood Elf)
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases to 35 feet. You also know the {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB} cantrip.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Longstrider|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Pass without Trace|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

sizeEntry.name: 體型：
entries: 小型（身高約 3–4 呎）

entries.name: 黑暗視覺
entries: 你擁有範圍 60 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB}。

entries.name: 地侏狡黠
entries: 你的智力、感知與魅力豁免檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}。

entries.name: 地侏血系
entries: 你屬於一個賦予你超自然能力的血系。從下列選項中擇一；無論選擇哪一個，智力、感知或魅力為你以此特性施展之法術的施法屬性（於選擇血系時決定）：

items.name: 森林地侏
entries: 你知道{@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB}戲法。你也總是準備著{@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB}法術。你可以不消耗法術欄位施展它，次數等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}時恢復所有已消耗的次數。你也可以使用你擁有的任何法術欄位施展該法術。

items.name: 岩石地侏
entries: 你知道{@spell Mending|XPHB}與{@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB}戲法。此外，你可以花費 10 分鐘施展{@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB}，製作一個微型發條裝置（AC 5，1 HP），例如玩具、點火器或音樂盒。製作裝置時，你從{@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB}中選擇一種效果來決定其功能；每當你或另一個生物執行一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}碰觸裝置以啟動它時，裝置便會產生該效果。若所選效果中有多種選項，你在製作裝置時為其選擇其中一種。例如，若你選擇該法術的點火／熄火效果，你要決定裝置是點火還是熄火，裝置不會兩者皆可。你同時最多可以擁有三個這樣的裝置，每個裝置會在製作後 8 小時，或你作為一個{@action Utilize|XPHB}動作碰觸將其拆解時散架。

items.name: Gnomish Lineage (Forest Gnome)
entries: You know the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} cantrip. You also always have the {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

items.name: Gnomish Lineage (Rock Gnome)
entries: You know the {@spell Mending|XPHB} and {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} cantrips. In addition, you can spend 10 minutes casting {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP), such as a toy, fire starter, or music box. When you create the device, you determine its function by choosing one effect from {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB}; the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to activate it with a touch. If the chosen effect has options within it, you choose one of those options for the device when you create it. For example, if you choose the spell's ignite-extinguish effect, you determine whether the device ignites or extinguishes fire; the device doesn't do both. You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.

sizeEntry.name: 體型：
entries: 中型（身高約 7–8 呎）

entries.name: 巨人血統
entries: 你是巨人的後裔。從下列益處中選擇一項——來自你血統的超自然恩賜；你可以使用所選益處的次數等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}時恢復所有已消耗的次數：

items.name: 雲之漫步（雲巨人）
entries: 作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}，你以魔法傳送至多 30 呎，到達一處你能看見的未被佔據空間。

items.name: 火之灼燒（火巨人）
entries: 當你以攻擊檢定命中一個目標並對其造成傷害時，你也可以對該目標造成 {@damage 1d10} 火焰傷害。

items.name: 霜之寒意（霜巨人）
entries: 當你以攻擊檢定命中一個目標並對其造成傷害時，你也可以對該目標造成 {@damage 1d6} 寒冷傷害，並使其{@variantrule Speed|XPHB}降低 10 呎，直到你的下個回合開始。

items.name: 丘之翻滾（山丘巨人）
entries: 當你以攻擊檢定命中一個大型或更小的生物並對其造成傷害時，你可以使該目標處於{@condition Prone|XPHB}狀態。

items.name: 石之堅忍（石巨人）
entries: 當你受到傷害時，你可以執行一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}擲 {@dice 1d12}。將你的體質調整值加到擲骰結果上，並使傷害減少該總和。

items.name: 暴風之雷（風暴巨人）
entries: 當你受到你 60 呎內一個生物的傷害時，你可以執行一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}，對該生物造成 {@damage 1d8} 雷鳴傷害。

entries.name: 大型形態
entries: 從角色等級 5 開始，若你所在的空間夠大，你可以作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}將你的體型變為大型。此變身持續 10 分鐘，或直到你結束它為止（無需動作）。在此期間，你的力量檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}，且你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB}增加 10 呎。使用此特性後，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}前都無法再次使用。

entries.name: 強健體格
entries: 你為終止{@condition Grappled|XPHB}狀態而進行的任何屬性檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}。在決定你的負重能力時，你也視為大一級的體型。

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Cloud)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Cloud's Jaunt
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Fire)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Fire's Burn
entries: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal {@damage 1d10} Fire damage to that target.

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Frost)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Frost's Chill
entries: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal {@damage 1d6} Cold damage to that target and reduce its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Hill)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Hill's Tumble
entries: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Stone)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Stone's Endurance
entries: When you take damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to roll {@dice 1d12}. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.

items.name: Giant Ancestry (Storm)
entries: You are descended from Giants, granting you a supernatural boon; you can use this boon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}:

items.name: Storm's Thunder
entries: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to deal {@damage 1d8} Thunder damage to that creature.

sizeEntry.name: 體型：
entries: 小型（身高約 2–3 呎）

entries.name: 勇敢
entries: 你為避免或終止{@condition Frightened|XPHB}狀態所進行的豁免檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}。

entries.name: 半身人靈巧
entries: 你可以穿過任何比你大一級或更大之生物的空間，但你不能停留在同一個空間中。

entries.name: 幸運
entries: 當你在{@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}的 {@dice d20} 上擲出 1 時，你可以重擲該骰子，且必須使用新的結果。

entries.name: 天生潛行
entries: 即使你只被一個比你至少大一級的生物遮蔽，你也可以執行{@action Hide|XPHB}動作。

sizeEntry.name: 體型：
entries: 中型（身高約 4–7 呎）或小型（身高約 2–4 呎），於選擇此種族時決定

entries.name: 足智多謀
entries: 每當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}時，你獲得{@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}。

entries.name: 技藝純熟
entries: 你獲得一項自選技能的熟練。

entries.name: 多才多藝
entries: 你獲得一個自選的{@filter 起源專長|feats|category=o}。

sizeEntry.name: 體型：
entries: 中型（身高約 6–7 呎）

entries.name: 腎上腺素爆發
entries: 你可以作為一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}執行{@action Dash|XPHB}動作。當你這麼做時，你獲得等同於你{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}的{@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}。
你可以使用此特性的次數等同於你的{@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|熟練加值}，並在完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}或{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}時恢復所有已消耗的次數。

entries.name: 黑暗視覺
entries: 你擁有範圍 120 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB}。

entries.name: 不屈堅忍
entries: 當你的{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}降至 0 但未被直接殺死時，你可以改為降至 1 點{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。使用此特性後，直到你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}前都無法再次使用。

sizeEntry.name: 體型：
entries: 中型（身高約 4–7 呎）或小型（身高約 3–4 呎），於選擇此種族時決定

entries.name: 黑暗視覺
entries: 你擁有範圍 60 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB}。

entries.name: 邪魔傳承
entries: 你繼承了一份賦予你超自然能力的傳承。從「邪魔傳承」表中選擇一個傳承。你獲得所選傳承的 1 級益處。
當你達到角色等級 3 與 5 時，你學會一道更高環的法術，如表中所示。你總是準備著該法術。你可以不消耗法術欄位施展它一次，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}時恢復以此方式施展它的能力。你也可以使用你擁有的適當環階法術欄位施展該法術。智力、感知或魅力為你以此特性施展之法術的施法屬性（於選擇傳承時決定）。

entries.caption: 邪魔傳承
rows: 你對毒素傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}。你也知道{@spell Poison Spray|XPHB}戲法。
你對黯蝕傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}。你也知道{@spell Chill Touch|XPHB}戲法。
你對火焰傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}。你也知道{@spell Fire Bolt|XPHB}戲法。

entries.name: 異界氣息
entries: 你知道{@spell Thaumaturgy|XPHB}戲法。當你以此特性施展它時，該法術使用與你的邪魔傳承特性相同的施法屬性。

items.name: Fiendish Legacy (Abyssal)
entries: You are the recipient of a legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage. You also know the {@spell Poison Spray|XPHB} cantrip.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Ray of Sickness|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Hold Person|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the legacy).
